mapper.select: SELECT * FROM trade_order WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND status=#{q.trades.statusCode} AND deleted_at='1970-01-01 00:00:00.000' ORDER BY created_at ASC,id ASC LIMIT #{q.pageSize} OFFSET #{q.offset}
SELECT id FROM trade_order WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND status=1 AND deleted_at='1970-01-01 00:00:00.000' ORDER BY created_at,id
SELECT id FROM trade_order WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND deleted_at='1970-01-01 00:00:00.000' AND id IN #{id} ORDER BY created_at,id

SELECT o.* FROM trade_order o JOIN ta_receipt r ON r.order_id=o.id WHERE o.user_id=#{userId} AND o.deleted_at='1970-01-01 00:00:00.000' ORDER BY r.received_at DESC,r.id DESC LIMIT #{q.pageSize} OFFSET #{q.offset}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO audit_log(actor_user_id,actor_role,action,object_type,object_id,object_name,detail,trace_id,occurred_at) VALUES(0,3,#{action},'ta_receipt_batch',#{id},'TA批量回执',CAST(#{detail} AS JSON),#{traceId},UTC_TIMESTAMP(3))
